Calculate 3- or 5-category gender variable

Source: R/calc-basic.R
calc_gender.Rd

Calculate 3- or 5-category gender variable

Usage

calc_gender(df, n_cat = 5)

Arguments

df

A data frame containing (at least) eHARS variables sex/birth_sex, LF_TRANS, LF_GENDER, and LF_GENDER_OTHER

n_cat

Number of categories to output; if 3, then all non-cisgender people included in a single 'Gender Diverse' category

Value

Input data frame df with the addition of variables (1) gender, and (2) transgender_ever

Examples

read_ehars_person(col_select = c(sex, LF_TRANS, LF_GENDER, LF_GENDER_OTHER)) |> dplyr::distinct() |> calc_gender() |> View()
#> Error: '//kc/dph/prevention/hiv/Epi/EXTRA SPACE/eHARS/Full eHARS/Archive/NA/person_sas7bdat/person.sas7bdat' does not exist.
